Commentary.Commentary: Mehedi Hasan was once again the star for the hosts with his second five-wicket haul. They will feel they conceded too many towards the end though and will know that they will have to bat well to stay ahead in the game. England will know batting last on this wicket won't be easy and hence will look to keep Bangladesh to a low score. Do join us for their second stint with the bat soon.

Yet another fine effort from the England lower order to get England back in the game after the top order was blown away. They were 50 for 3 starting the day but were soon reduced to 69 for 5. It was Joe Root who struck a vital fifty to get them past 150. Once he fell, it was the pair of Woakes and Rashid who struck a 99-run stand to wipe out the deficit and ensure that they stayed in the game sneaking in a 24-run lead.

Welcome back for the second session of play! CHRIS WOAKES AND ADIL RASHID are out to bat for ENGLAND. BANGLADESH begin the session with MEHEDI HASAN. Here we go...
...DAY 2...SESSION 2...

Wickets though kept falling at the other end as Mehedi took his second five-wicket haul dismissing Ansari. Root then fell to Taijul who bowled right through the first session. The runs have come for England but they will know this was the best time to bat and any lead will be handy. They will hope Rashid and Woakes can carry on and sneak in a lead here. They are still 57 runs behind and Bangladesh will hope to wrap them up early and get batting on a wicket that is getting harder to score on. Do join us in a while for the second session.

Phew! What a session of Test cricket! Lot of overs - 39.3 in total, 5 wickets and hard earned 113 runs too for England. They lost Moeen Ali and Ben Stokes early but Joe Root held one end up for them. He combined with Jonny Bairstow then to keep Bangladesh at bay stitching a 45-run stand. Root brought up his fifty but Mehedi broke the stand for the hosts.

Flatter on the pads, Root fails to clip it through. The ball rolls away towards leg gully for a single. Leg bye signaled.
A touch flatter outside off, Root goes back and punches it to covers.
Floated on off, Root comes forward and pushes it back down the wicket.
A change that should have come sometime back, SHAKIB AL HASAN into the attack for the first time today.
Floated outside off, Root pushes it past gully for a quick single.
Slanted on middle, Bairstow comes down and works it through square leg for a single.
Shorter on off, goes back and punches it to covers.
Landed outside off, comes forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Bairstow comes forward and defends it.
Floated outside off, Root pushes it to covers for a quick single. The throw comes in at the non-striker's end and replays show had he hit, that was out.
This one spins down the leg side, left alone.
Shorter outside off, keeps a touch low, Bairstow does well to cut it through covers for a couple of runs.
Flatter on off, Bairstow stays back and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Root comes down and clips it through mid on for a single.
Shorter on middle going further down, worked away to square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, comes in, Bairstow looks to defend but is hit on his body off the pads.
Stays back and punches it past point for a single.
Fuller on middle, Root sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Flatter on middle, spins away, Root punches it back down the wicket.
Flatter on middle, Root comes forward and defends it.
Full toss outside off, Bairstow premeditates the paddle and gets it down to fine leg for three. Good work in the deep from the fielder.
Floated on off, Bairstow comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Drives it through covers for a single.
Bairstow stays back and keeps this one out.
Defended towards the on side.
Flatter on middle, Root clips it through mid-wicket in the air for a single.
Floated outside off, Bairstow comes forward, taps it to covers and calls Root through for a quick single.
Flatter on off, Jonny works it towards short leg who fires the throw back in a jiffy.
Flatter on off, spins away sharply. Root goes back to defend it but is beaten by the turn on that one. Brilliant ball to end the over.
Fuller on off, Root comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Too full on the pads, Root clips it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, spins away, Root plays inside the line and keeps his bat out.
Root comes forward and defends it.
Bowled on middle, Bairstow drives it towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Hit away! Shorter on the pads, Root rolls his wrists and gets it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. That was neatly done!
Another one turns down the leg side, Root lets it go.
Floated on middle, Root again goes back and just about manages to get his bat out of the way and let's it hit his pads as the ball is going down leg.
On the pads, Root lets it hit his pads since he knew that the ball pitched outside leg.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter down the leg side, Bairstow lets it go through.
Goes around the wicket, Mehedi. A leg gully, short leg in place.
Fuller on middle, Bairstow comes forward and drills it through mid off where the fielder dives and keeps them to a single.
Bairstow goes back and defends it off his crease.
JONNY BAIRSTOW walks in.

OUT! STOKES DEPARTS! Floated outside off, spins in sharply, Stokes looks to tuck it off his back foot. The ball goes off the inside edge onto his pads and goes towards short leg. Mominul dives forward and takes a superb catch inches off the ground. The players celebrate but the umpire S Ravi goes across to have a chat with Dharamasena and they refer it upstairs. Replays show that it was a clean catch and Stokes has to go. ENGLAND 69 for 5 and still trail the hosts by 151 runs!
Ben Stokes is out or is he? The third umpire is referred for a catch appeal at short leg. Stokes is almost halfway through.

EDGED! Flatter on middle, turns away, Root comes forward to defend this one but gets an outside edge. The ball flies past the keeper's glove and then of the first slip's hands down to third man. The fielder does well at third man to keep them down three. Tough chance gone down!
Shorter on off, punched through covers for a couple.
Fuller on middle, Root comes forward and defends it.
Flatter on off, sharp spin away from Stokes who is again beaten on his back foot.
TURN! Floated outside off, turns away, Stokes is beaten by the turn as he looks to defend from his back foot.
Floated outside off, Stokes comes forward and defends it.
BEN STOKES is the new man in.

OUT! Poor shot! Flatter outside off, Ali looks to go down on his knee and sweep it but fails to connect. The ball cannons into the stumps and Mehedi roars in joy. That is a poor shot from Moeen and Bangladesh have the wicket they wanted early.
Tossed up on off, Ali comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! Poor ball! Full toss on off, Ali clips it away through mid-wicket for a boundary. The runs are coming easily for England for now.
Ali sweeps this one from outside off, to fine leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Ali comes forward and defends it with an inside edge towards the on side.
FOUR BYES! Bowls it outside off, spins in, Ali does not bother as he watches it spin. The keeper dives to his right but cannot stop it. The ball runs down to the fine leg fence. Byes signaled.
This one spins away from Root who punches it through covers for a single.
Fuller on middle, Ali pushes it through mid on for a single.
Floated outside off, Root drives in the air towards covers where Shakib mops and keeps them to a single.
TAIJUL ISLAM to bowl from the other end.

Just short! Floated outside off, Ali comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge and that just falls short of Mahmudullah at first slip. That was really well held. Good start to the day for Mehedi.
A touch flatter outside off, goes straight, left alone by Ali.
Edged! Floated outside off, Ali comes forward and looks to defend but gets an edge through backward point for a couple of runs.
Right then! Time for the action. The players are out in the middle. MOEEN ALI and JOE ROOT are out to bat for England. MEHEDI HASAN to complete his over. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Rob Key reckons there are more cracks on offer and it will turn a lot more than yesterday. He adds that batting will get tougher with more turn and bounce on offer. Mentions that people who have the right intent (to score) will do well on this deck.

England will hope the middle order bails them off again but it won't be an easy task. The home side have plenty of spin options and will look to exploit the conditions. This Test could really move ahead quickly. Stay tuned for all the action.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Day 2 of the second Test between Bangladesh and England. We have an early start today due to the rain yesterday. The game is nicely poised for now, the home side collapsed from 171 for 1 to get bowled out for 220. England though were jolted early and were reduced to 50 for 3 when the heavens opened up.
...DAY 2...SESSION 1...

Right then, Bangladesh are poised nicely at the moment as they have kept England in check and clawed their way back. England will bank on their in-form middle order to bail them out again. It will be an early start tomorrow to rope in the extra overs. We hope you enjoyed our coverage! Join us tomorrow for all the action. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Earlier in the day, it was Tamim-Mominul show as they stitched together a 170-run partnership to put England on the back foot. The former went onto score his eighth Test century but fell soon after that. Mominul departed for 66 and that opened the floodgates as they kept on losing wickets in a jiffy and derailed to 220 all out. Ali was the star for England as he took a fifer and Stokes proved to be the perfect foil for him as he reverse swung the ball to take two crucial wickets.

What an exciting day of Cricket! 270 runs scored and 13 wickets fell. Bangladesh would be happy to have come back hard with the ball as they have picked up three crucial wickets. They wasted no time as they began with spin from both ends and that paid off big time. Shakib and Mehedi spun the ball appreciably and troubled the English batsmen. The former took the first wicket and the latter grabbed two wickets to jolt them.
1615 IST - The rain continues to fall and the umpires have decided to call it a Day.

1605 IST - The players are walking off the field due to rain! England won't mind the break but not sure if Bangladesh wanted it. They were right on top here and would have loved to take one more wicket today. Let's see we get any more play.
Ali reaches out to the loopy delivery and defends it solidly.
It has started to drizzle and the light is not good too!
Flighted delivery around off, Ali comes forward and defends to the off side.
Ali presses forward and defends down the pitch.
Full toss on middle, clipped nicely through mid-wicket for a couple. 50 up for England.
Outside off, spinning away. Root shapes to cut but is beaten.
Flatter and quicker at the stumps, Root stays back and manages to keep it out.
Quicker one on middle, clipped towards the leg side.
Fullish ball, Root plays it with an angled bat towards point.
FOUR! SHOT! A tad short outside off, Root rocks back and punches it  beautifully through the covers. The ball beats the two fielders in the deep and speeds to the boundary.
Outside off, spinning away. Ali lets it go through.
Ali stays back to the shorter delivery and defends.
Ali presses forward and blocks.
Tossed up outside off, Ali comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge that flies past slip and goes towards third man. Ali gets off the mark with a couple.
MOEEN ALI comes in to bat. Not sure if would have expected this when he took five earlier in the day.

OUT! THAT'S A RIPPER! Ballance has to depart. Tossed up around off, spins away. Ballance leans ahead to negotiate it but gets a faint edge that goes straight into the hands of Rahim and he pouches it safely. England are in a spot of bother now!
Ballance prods forward and plays inside the line of this delivery. It zips through to the keeper.
A tad short outside off, spinning away. Root plays it towards point.
Tossed up, Root comes forward and defends towards short leg.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery.
Tossed up around middle and off, Root lunges forward and defends it towards the off side.
Root gets his head down and defends down the pitch.
On middle and leg, Root defends off the front foot.
Ballance comes forward and defends down the pitch.

Two Leg byes. Tossed up outside off, coming in with the arm. Ballance goes back and looks to cut but is rapped on the back pad. There is a muted appeal but in vain. The impact was clearly outside off. Two leg byes taken as the ball rolled towards third man.
Ballance prods forward and defends towards short leg.
Coming in with the arm, Ballance comes forward to defend but misses and is struck on the pads. Stifled appeal for LBW turned down.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one outside off, spins in. Root stays back and defends.
Root drives it through covers for a single.
Fuller on off, Ballance comes down and slams it down the wicket but the ball hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. The ball deflects towards mid on and they take a single.
Shorter outside off, turns away, Root punches it to covers for a single.
Flatter on off, Root stays back and defends it.
Fuller on middle, Root comes forward and turns it towards the leg side.
Flatter on middle, Root defends it off the inside edge towards short fine leg.
Tossed up outside off, Ballance comes forward and plays inside the line and is beaten.
Floated on middle, Ballance comes forward and defends it with an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Short outside off, pushed to covers by Ballance.
Flatter outside off, Ballance looks to defend from his crease but is beaten.
FOUR! Poor ball! Full toss on the pads, Ballance comes forward and clips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. The runs are flowing now for England. Bangladesh need some control.
FOUR! In the gap! Shorter on off, Ballance goes back and works it wide of mid on. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Root mistimes his drive towards mid on.
Floated on middle, Root comes forward and looks to sweep but gets an inside edge through square leg.
Flatter on the pads, Root fails to clip it through.
Defends this one from his crease.
FOUR! Root cuts this one through the covers for a boundary.
Root comes forward and defends it.
Too full on the pads, Ballance works it through the leg side for a single.
Ballance keeps this one out.
Ballance comes forward and defends it.
Ballance punches this one towards covers.
Almost another one! The ball is turning like a Cobra! Floated outside off, Ballance looks to defend but is beaten all ends up by the turn.

OUT! COOK DEPARTS! Flatter on the stumps, Cook fails to work it through and is rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire says no. That looked to be going down leg. Rahim takes his time and goes for the review. Replays confirm there was no bat there and three reds and the crowd roars. That is a superb call on the review. GARY BALLANCE is the new man in.
Root comes forward and drives it to covers.
EDGED! Finally flights this one around off, Root is forward and looks to defend but gets an outside edge just wide of the first slip fielder.
Root looks to clip another one off his back foot but misses.
Short outside off, Root camps back and cuts it towards point. Shakib needs to bring Root forward.
Flatter on the pads, Root goes back and tucks it wide of short leg.

FOUR! Almost a wicket! A quicker one on off, Cook looks to work it off his back foot but gets opened up at the last moment. He almost guides it to gully. The ball goes between first slip and gully and down to third man fence.
Floated on off, Cook is forward and defends it.
FOUR! Shot, Cook! Shorter on off, Cook goes back and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. That raced away to the fence. Superb work there, Cook!
Fuller outside off, Cook pushes it to covers.
FOUR! PUNCHED! A touch short outside off, Cook rocks back and punches it nicely through covers for a boundary. That was really well timed.
Floated on middle, Root clips it to backward square leg for a single.
Flatter on middle, Root goes back and works it just past short leg for a single to get off the mark. That was not off the middle.
JOE ROOT walks in to bat. This a crucial pair for England, if Bangladesh can break this stand early, this could really get interesting.

OUT! SHAKIB STRIKES! Tossed up on middle and leg, Duckett looks to work it through mid-wicket but only manages to glove it through to the keeper for a good catch. Duckett walks and that is an ideal start for Shakib. The Test is moving at a rapid pace here.
Too full on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter down the leg side, Duckett lets it go. The ball goes past the keeper and they sneak a bye.

SIX! If Tamim, so can I says Duckett! Floated on middle and off, Duckett slinks down the wicket and gets under this one and lofts it up and over long on for a maximum. That is a great sign of intent from England!
Floated on middle, Duckett defends it.
No nonsense from Bangladesh, SHAKIB AL HASAN to bowl from the other end. A slip in place, along with leg slip and short leg in place too.
Cook comes forward and this time he defends it.
Cook is beaten by another one that spins away a touch after pitching.
Loud shout for caught behind! Bowls it outside off, pitches and spins away sharply, Cook is beaten on his forward defensive prod. Rahim almost celebrates even before he has caught that one.
Another short ball, this one is cut to point.
Short again outside off, cut to sweeper cover for a run.
Shorter outside off, Cook slaps it through covers for a single to get off the mark. Surprisingly there is a deep cover in place already!
